recipes.startdescription: I have something to fix or build for the engineers to do. Get to it.

recipes.label: Assign Extra Provisions to an ally
recipes.startdescription: Assigning extra resources to my allies will increase their effectiveness at what they do.
recipes.description: And done. My ally will be more effective, now.

recipes.label: Command Scouts
recipes.startdescription:
The broad movements of the sky and the air can threaten the unprepared, but my scouts can devise a way to turn even this to our advantage.

[This will convert a Hindrance into a useful Opportunity.]

recipes.label: Command Scouts
recipes.startdescription: I have something for my scouts to uncover. Find it.

recipes.label: Command Scouts
recipes.startdescription: I have an enemy I need intelligence on, and these are the men to get it.

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Scouts
recipes.startdescription: I have an enemy I need intelligence on, and these are the men to get it.
recipes.description: The scouts return, with information on my enemy.

recipes.label: Command Allies to Attack an Enemy
recipes.startdescription:
The enemy is ahead. I will need a strategy, and then the resources and manpower to execute it. Or, failing that, a willingness to throw away the lives of my allies.

[You can only do three of these simulatenously. Failing the attack has a higher chance of wounding and outright killing the ally, but wont give you any wounds or trauma.]

recipes.label: Command an Ally to Attack an Enemy
recipes.startdescription:
The enemy is ahead. I will need a strategy, and then the resources and manpower to execute it. Or, failing that, a willingness to throw away the lives of my allies.

[Meet any of an Enemy's thresholds to launch an attack against it. Exceed a threshold by at least 5 of the appropriate aspect, and the attack will be a guaranteed success]

recipes.label: Spread Too Thin
recipes.startdescription: I can't coordinate this many attacks at once. I'm going to have to wait for one to finish before sending more men out. [You can only do three ally attacks simultaneously.]

recipes.label: Command Soviets to Attack an Enemy
recipes.startdescription:
The enemy is ahead. I will need a strategy, and then the resources and manpower to execute it. Or, failing that, a willingness to throw away the lives of my allies.

[You can only do three of these simulatenously. Failing the attack has a higher chance of wounding and outright killing the ally, but wont give you any wounds or trauma.]

recipes.label: Command Ally into Hiding
recipes.startdescription:
To the dark. Our enemy won't be able to find us, or harm us. And when we choose to strike again, it will be with the advantage of surprise...

[A Hidden Ally will not be targeted by most Enemy offensive actions, and will also have their aspects increased until the next time they are used.]
